OK, sorry if it was confusing to create so many Presto shells. I'm just looking for a way to get out in front of it instead of creating the shells while writing observations or after filing stories, which can be frustrating at times.

From: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 29, 2019 7:02:14 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Cc: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>; Sung, Elaine <ESung@freepress.com>; Ford, Ryan <rford@freepress.com>; Alter, Marlowe <malter@freepress.com>
Subject: Tigers stories on budget
Make sure you’re putting your stories on the budget. Especially as the content flow increases, stuff can slip through the cracks.
Also, try to alter your slug names so that all parties on the desk can keep up with what’s what.
